Subject: Post-call: SOC 2 & audit logs discussion / Next steps

Hi Aisha & Tom,

Thanks again for taking the time today — really productive conversation. Quick recap from our discovery so the team is aligned and we have clear next steps.

Key pain points you described:
- Need verified SOC 2 evidence for your security review (controls around logging, monitoring).
- Audit log retention and exportability: compliance requires searchable logs for 7 years and ability to deliver extracts for audits.
- Data residency and encryption at rest/in transit; SCIM provisioning for SSO access controls.
- Need pen test summary / vulnerability evidence to satisfy procurement gates.

Goals we agreed:
1) Confirm Redwood can provide SOC 2 attestation and supporting evidence for logging controls.
2) Validate log retention/export capabilities and retention policy options.
3) Review DPA terms (data retention, subprocessor list, breach notification SLAs).
4) Schedule a technical deep-dive with your infra/security engineering to walk through logging, KV cache behavior, and export paths.

What I’m sharing now:
- Redwood_SOC2_Report_2025.pdf (attached) 

Planned next steps:
- Marissa (cc) will share a pen-test summary and DPA draft for your review.
- Can we schedule a 60-minute technical deep-dive next week (30-45m demo + 15-30m Q&A)? I shared a Calendly link below; happy to book on your behalf if you share preferred slots.

Proposed attendees:
- From ZenWell: CISO / security engineer (for logs/arch questions), procurement.
- From Redwood: Marissa (Security & Compliance), Rishi (Solutions Architect), myself.

Links: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/8421 | https://calendly.com/neha-kapoor/rw-tech-deep-dive

Thanks — I’ll follow up as Marissa shares the additional artifacts.

Best,
Neha Kapoor

Neha,

Appreciate the recap and the SOC 2 report — good start. A couple of clarifying items from our side: 

1) Retention: Our compliance team requires log retention of up to 7 years for security events with the ability to export as CSV/JSON for legal holds. Can Redwood support configurable retention windows per-tenant and an export API?

2) Audit logs: We need assurance that admin/change events (role changes, token issuance, config changes) are logged with immutable timestamps and are tamper-evident.

3) Pen test evidence: procurement will want a high-level summary of pen test scopes, date, remediation status — not the raw findings.

4) DPA: Please send your standard DPA (we typically redline) and indicate if you support EU Addendum clauses (we may involve EU legal later).

Timing: Tue/Thu next week look best for a tech deep-dive. Prefer afternoon PST.

Thanks — I’ll wait for Marissa and Rishi to share artifacts and proposed times.

Regards,
Aisha Khan
CISO, ZenWell Health
aisha.khan@zenwell.com

Hi Aisha, Neha,

Thanks for the clear ask, Aisha. Attaching the pen test summary and our current DPA draft for your legal/procurement team to review. Notes below on the specific items you raised: 

- Retention and export: Redwood supports configurable retention policies per-tenant; default is 365 days but we can extend to multi-year retention (we have customers on 7-year retention). Logs are exportable via our Audit Export API (CSV/JSON) and we can bundle extracts for legal hold requests.

- Audit log guarantees: Admin events, token issuance, role changes, and configuration changes are logged to an append-only store. We provide HMAC-based integrity markers in exports and maintain immutable timestamps in the event journal. Full forensic exports include event hashes and signing metadata.

- Encryption: Data is encrypted at rest with customer-managed keys available for dedicated/private deployments; TLS 1.2+ in transit.

- Pen test: Attached is a redacted summary (date/scope/remediation status). We do not share raw PII-bearing findings in initial exchanges; we can arrange an NDA if deeper sharing is required.

Attachments included: Redwood-pen-test-summary.zip, Redwood-DPA-v3.docx

Let me know if you want a short pre-call with our solutions team to go line-by-line on the export format. Otherwise we can present during the technical deep-dive.

Marissa Cole
Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
